description: The current Bank of Israel (BOI) policy interest rate for ISRAEL — the Israeli benchmark rate set by the Bank of Israel Monetary Committee, in % per annum. Returns rate, the date it took effect (effective_since), the previous rate and when that one took effect, plus recent decision history, sourced from the Monetary Committee's own published decisions (not just currentInterest's bare snapshot). Also returns nextInterestDate (the next scheduled decision) and lastPublishedDate. Scope: Israel only.
name: boi_interest_rate
title: Boi Interest Rate
